name: Threat From the Sea
summary: After Tok'Kar sends you to speak with Katar, Katar makes plain a hatred of the sea. Watching the fish men die at the hands of anyone who does the Horde's will gives Katar some pleasure, and Katar asks how many you can slay and whether you would test yourself against their strongest kind.

sections.title: A Grudge Against the Sea
sections.body: Katar bears no affection for the sea or for any creature that comes out of it, and calls it a mistress strong but blind, callous and brutal. Killing the fish men by the hundreds would delight Katar, were it possible, and watching them fall to those who serve the Horde gives a little satisfaction. Katar, in the Swamp of Sorrows, asks you to slay marsh murlocs, marsh inkspewers and marsh flesheaters.

sections.title: Katar's Verdict
sections.body: On your return, Katar says the sea may seem vast and relentless, yet her own offspring now bear your bloody mark. The fish men now know pain and must rebuild their ranks, which Katar finds good, and Katar will smile each time one is silenced. Katar invites you back to slay more.

faq.q: Why does Katar want the murlocs destroyed?
faq.answer: Katar bears no love for the sea or what comes out of it, and would gladly see the fish men slain by the hundreds. Watching them die to those who do the Horde's will gives some pleasure.

faq.q: Where does this hunt take place?
faq.answer: In the Swamp of Sorrows, among marsh murlocs, marsh inkspewers and marsh flesheaters.

aliases: who gives threat from the sea
faq.answer: Katar, whom Tok'Kar sent you to speak with in the Swamp of Sorrows.

aliases: threat from the sea previous quest
faq.answer: It follows the first Threat From the Sea, in which Tok'Kar sent you to speak with Katar.
